frame.basis: Multiply all original-frame coordinate spans by retained 60/19. Do not fit to the previous 6 m mesh.

stockComponents.basis: Design equivalent 6 mm shell stock at 2000 kg/m3 plus 2 kg/m2 distributed shell seam and flange allowance. Fixed hardware is separate.

Design equivalent 8 mm laminate at 1250 kg/m3 plus 1.5 kg/m2 distributed seal allowance. Native faces are a closed collision lid; source mass ownership does not depend on opaque collision material or optical alpha.

intrinsicHardware.basis: 12 kg compact sealed local impulse and regulator assembly. Fixed design mass allowance, no propellant inventory or weapon.
Identical mirrored fixed assembly. The clock role never drives these units.
12 kg sealed battery and distribution allowance. Nominal mission energy is not a battery mass conversion.
32 kg thermal exchanger, pump, insulation and sealed coolant, as one fixed service assembly.
6 kg controller and beacon instrumentation allowance, independent of scripted clock performance.
5 kg sealed atmosphere and monitoring cartridge including fixed contents.

intrinsicHardware.layout: Opaque cryostasis couch, opaque pressure-shell cradle mount and both restraint rails in the display part map. One engineering mass lump at the designed assembly centre.
intrinsicHardware.basis: 18 kg budget for lightweight bed, shell mount and mechanical occupant restraints. Decorative triangles do not contribute stock mass.

intrinsicHardware.layout: Symmetric integrated lid-rail hardware along the two side rails. One engineering mass lump at their common midpoint.
intrinsicHardware.basis: 6 kg hardware budget for hinges and latch. Distributed seal is already charged in lid stock.

absence.basis: Dry empty design. The frozen person is display-only. The new local attitude hardware is enclosed; no removed legacy casing or weapon assembly is carried forward.

momentRule: Existing independent triangle area moment plus fixed hardware point allocations. Scale each vertex and hardware centre by 60/19 once. Sum stock area times areal density, mass first and full second moments. Shift to COM and verify full positive inertia and source-origin parallel-axis consistency. Apply whole-kilogram round-up reserve at COM only. Do not include decorative geometry or the historical SH040 record.
qualification: G1 computes and checks the physical record, validates envelope and assembly fit/clearance and composes exact same-ID source binding. Occupied capsule operation, actuated lid clearance, people/custody and installed power behaviour require actual runtime evidence. Glass Meridian clock IDs, placement, scale, energy, zero motion and weapons come from its unchanged mission definition.
